Enroll one explicit server account.

Source: R/curation_auth.R
curation_auth_enroll_account.Rd

This is an operator function, not an app route. If secret is omitted, a random secret is generated and returned only to this caller for private provisioning. Calling this function is the only operation that can create an account; opening the store never bootstraps a user.

Usage

curation_auth_enroll_account(
  auth,
  username,
  actor_id = username,
  display_name = username,
  roles = "reviewer",
  secret = NULL,
  replace = FALSE
)

curation_auth_enroll(...)

Arguments

auth

A store from curation_auth_open().

username

Login username.

actor_id

Stable server-side actor ID.

display_name

Informational display name.

roles

reviewer and/or admin.

secret

Optional existing RFC 4648 base32 secret.

replace

Replace an existing username only when explicitly requested.

...

Arguments forwarded to curation_auth_enroll_account().

Value

A list containing account metadata and the enrollment secret.
